# Unvent Automations

> Operations firm in Los Angeles, California. We walk a business's whole operation, put a dollar number on each gap, and build the systems that close them: the phone, quotes, follow-ups, invoicing, scheduling, and reporting.

## What we build
- Find the work: new leads from public records every morning, such as new pool permits, hail-damaged blocks after a storm, and active construction sites.
- Follow it up: every quote chased on schedule, not when someone remembers.
- Run the back office: invoices, payment reminders, and the weekly report sent on their own.

## How an engagement works
- The first call is thirty minutes and mostly questions. You leave it with every gap we found costed in dollars, whether or not you hire us.
- We build what pays for itself first. The first systems are live in about a week.
- Every build is quoted after the walkthrough. Some are a flat build fee, some are paid out of what the system brings back, plus a monthly retainer.
- Month to month, thirty days' notice. The phone number ports out with you.
- You work directly with the people who build it.
